blocks.text: Bu ders karşılaştırma üzerine: «bu oda bizimkinden ucuz», «bu mağazanın teslimatı en hızlı», «bu kahve seninki kadar sert», «çanta fazla büyük», «aramız çok iyi». Neredeyse hepsi sıfata eklenen küçük parçalarla kurulur.

examples.en: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.
examples.translation: Bu otel odası bizimkinden daha ucuz.

examples.en: This shop has the shortest delivery time.
This instant coffee is as strong as yours.
examples.translation: Bu hazır kahve seninki kadar sert.

examples.en: This cabin bag is too big.
We have such a good relationship.

blocks.text: «Daha ucuz», «daha sessiz», «daha uzun» için sıfata -er eklenir; «-den» ise than olur ve kıyaslanan şeyden önce gelir: cheaper than ours. «Daha» zaten -er'in içinde: more cheaper denmez.

examples.en: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.
examples.translation: Bu otel odası bizimkinden daha ucuz.

examples.en: The shared bathroom is cleaner than before.
The train journey is shorter than ours.
The airport bus is slower than a taxi.
These leather shoes are softer than that pair.
examples.translation: Bu deri ayakkabılar o çiftten daha yumuşak.

fixes.wrong: This hotel room is more cheaper than ours.
fixes.right: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.

fixes.wrong: This hotel room is cheap than ours.
fixes.right: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.

fixes.wrong: The shared bathroom is cleaner that before.
fixes.right: The shared bathroom is cleaner than before.

blocks.text: Hepsinin arasından birini seçiyorsan — «en ucuz», «en yakın» — sıfata -est eklenir ve önüne mutlaka the gelir: the shortest delivery time, the nearest shop. «En» zaten -est'in içinde: most cheapest denmez.

examples.en: This shop has the shortest delivery time.
This clinic has the longest waiting time.
This local shop is the nearest.
The plain yoghurt is the cheapest option.
We booked the earliest home visit.
examples.translation: En erken ev ziyaretine randevu aldık.

fixes.wrong: This shop has shortest delivery time.
fixes.right: This shop has the shortest delivery time.

fixes.wrong: This shop has the most shortest delivery time.
fixes.right: This shop has the shortest delivery time.

drill.question: Üç mağazaya bakıyorsun. Bu en büyüğü. Ne dersin?
drill.optionA: This chain store is the larger.
drill.optionB: This chain store is the largest.

blocks.text: Fark yoksa — «seninki kadar sert» — sıfat iki as arasına girer: as strong as yours. Türkçede «kadar» tek kelime ve sonda; İngilizcede iki as var ve sıfat -er almaz.

examples.en: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.
examples.translation: Bu hazır kahve seninki kadar sert.

examples.en: This green tea is as cheap as that one.
examples.translation: Bu yeşil çay o çay kadar ucuz.

examples.en: These reading glasses are as light as mine.
examples.translation: Bu okuma gözlükleri benimkiler kadar hafif.

examples.en: This electric kettle is as fast as ours.
examples.translation: Bu elektrikli su ısıtıcısı bizimki kadar hızlı.

fixes.wrong: This ground coffee is fresh as yours.
fixes.right: This ground coffee is as fresh as yours.

fixes.wrong: This instant coffee is as strong than yours.
fixes.right: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.

fixes.wrong: This instant coffee is as stronger as yours.
fixes.right: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.

blocks.text: too — «fazla», engel olur: This cabin bag is too big. enough — «yeterince», uygun: This checked bag is light enough. Türkçede «yeterince» sıfattan önce gelir, İngilizcede enough sıfattan sonra.

examples.en: This cabin bag is too big.
This checked bag is light enough.
The monthly rent is too high.
The rental deposit is low enough.
This driveway is too narrow.

fixes.wrong: This checked bag is enough light.
fixes.right: This checked bag is light enough.

fixes.right: This cabin bag is too big.

blocks.text: Arkasından şey gelmiyorsa — so: My close friend is so kind. Sıfattan sonra bir şey geliyorsa — such: such a helpful person, such hard work. Sıra such a'dır, a such değil.

formula.text: şey var: such a + sıfat + şey

Our mutual friend is such a helpful person.

examples.en: This is such hard work.
examples.translation: Bu öyle ağır bir iş ki.

examples.en: The live music is so loud.

blocks.text: İki şey — -er than. Hepsinin içinde biri — the -est. Aynı — as … as. Engel — too sıfattan önce, uygun — enough sonra. Şey yoksa so, varsa such a.
-er than — ikisini karşılaştır. the -est — hepsinden birini seç. as … as — «aynı». too / enough — «fazla» ve «yeterince». so / such — so arkasında şey yokken, such şeyle birlikte.

examples.en: The sale price is lower than before.
This dining table is the widest.
This is such a big improvement.
